title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. One of my non-muslim friend comes to my home and everytime he touch feet of my dad so i feel very bad when i go to his home and doesn't do it. To give respect to elders can we touch feet of elders, muslims or non-muslims? If not what are the other ways by which we can give them respect. Please suggest. Jazaakumullah... 8697 views Q. Allah stated in Quran in surah AL-Ahqaf verse#15"AND WE HAVE ENJOINED MAN TO BE DUTIFUL AND KIND TO HIS PARENTS."does this imply only on man not woman,I want to know the duties of woman towards her parents. 1925 views Q. I have a question about greeting elders. In our culture, the young bend down to greet their elders and the elders put their hand over the head and make a dua. I wanted to know if it is permissible Islamically to greet your father, grandfather, etc. by lowering the head? 5211 views Q. My father and my chacha (my father's brother) are not talking to each other from a long time due to some misunderstanding 2172 views Q. Family matters 2528 views Q. If one's wife wants to live in a separate house with husband, will it be wajib for him to do so 4377 views Q. I have been encountered many times and heard many things that shaking the hands with 1 hand is sunnat. Some say it is 2 hands 1717 views Q. An Alim once said in a bayan that "destroying the Baitullah is little sin whereas hurting a Muslim is Bigger sin in comparison to that". I was shocked listening it! Is that valid? if so, what is meant for Muslim here; any muslim or only muttaki, mufti, Imam, Alim etc. ? In what condition, the claim is right or wrong. 1816 views Q. Salaam, I am in a very big Exam from Allah (SWT). I recently got married. I knew before marriage that there is a girl very much in love with my husband (in the family). But despite that he got married to me. In the beginning I could sense that he doesn't love me. But as I gave him so much love and respect in every single way. He has started to love me aswell. We live in the UK and the girl that loves my husband lives in Pakistan. She calls and annoys us Every single day.. she doesn't talk on the phone but just to hear his voice. Then Once she said hello to him when he picked up. He straight away hung up but didn't mention it to me. which made me really upset because I heard her voice aswell but didn't say anything either. Few days later I confessed to him that I know everything and then again when she called and said hello to him.. he gave the phone to me and I heard her saying hello again. Then I hung up. Since then I have been very upset that she is STILL annoying me and my husband. I want a piece of mind and just want too forget EVERYTHING and give my husband the same love as I used to.. but now I give him rude answers and break his heart. I can see in his eyes that he gets really hurt by the harsh things I say sometimes, but I can't help it. Shaitan tells me he is not worth my love. Please can you give me a dua so the Love between us grows more and so I can get over the whole situation. For the first time we had a fight today and I don't feel upset at all.. my mind is saying 'Good he deserves it' but my heart is crying tears of blood. I pray Alhamdulillah and I ask ALLAH (SWT) for Sabr and strenght.. but somehow shaitan in my head takes it over. Please Help me. I love my husband to bits and I cannot hurt him on purpose but shaitan makes me hurt him. I am also pregnant and I am worried that this much tension will have effect on my pregnancy. Please Help Me. Jazakallah khair.. 3277 views Q. My sister married 2 months back. His Mother in law always scolding. each time they hurt each and every moment. My Sister husband does not support. 90% he is not support 10% support. 10 minutes or 1 days he/his mother talks/behave well after a minutes or day he/she shouted her. she keep calm. 2 days before problem goes like that she trying to suicide. any solution for this quran and hadith? 2025 views Q. As'salamu alaikum va rahmathullahi va barakathou!! Can we greet a Non Muslim with Salam? If not Why? Jazakallahu Khairan 4351 views Q. Assalamualaikum, Dear Sir, with due respect i wanted to ask you that leaving parents behind for the sake of better career is rightful or not? Note that the parents both are healthy, managing their financial status by themselves in a good way, other younger brothers still living with them, also they are showing complete happiness about the situation, my point is that one always know that parents are never happy at heart for leaving the kids stay away from them (even if they have many) but always are happy as they want their kids to grow & propser. JAZAKALLAH' KHAIR. Wassalam 11575 views Q. In hadith it has been mentioned in the near meaning that when a person visits some ones house then he should take permission three times for entering if permission not given then he should go back, the question is that because in the hadith it mentions the words go back is it permissible , haram, makrooh tahreemi or makrooh tanzihee to knock on some ones door more than three times?Question 2- If a person knocks on some ones door more than three times thinking that the they probably did not hear the three knocks then is it permissible? 5845 views Q. I am having feelings for a boy I know. I know it is wrong, but i can not stop thinking about him. Can u please tell me what i should do? 2037 views Q. As'salamu alaikum Mufti Sb., In our Office both Muslims & Non-Muslims are working. Due to Islam country, in general both Muslims and Non-muslims are told Salamalikum each other. My usual practive is while Non-muslims was told Salamalikum, I was replied him just Walaikum(One Mowlwi told me to respond non-muslim brother like that only). But my friend non-muslim, while I was told just walaikum, he asked me why u r not told Walaikumassalam. Kindly advise me how shall I manage with him. 2918 views
answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 7599 Country: Bangladesh Title: Assalamu-alaikum, While 'Yawning' takes place, what should we do? Someone says, we should control it at our best, if not possible, then we can use the front side of left hand to cover-up the mouth. Another alim says, rather reverse side of pump of the left hand should be used to cover-up. Which one is correct? Zazakallahu khairan. Question: Assalamu-alaikum, While 'Yawning' takes place, what should we do? Someone says, we should control it at our best, if not possible, then we can use the front side of left hand to cover-up the mouth. Another alim says, rather reverse side of pump of the left hand should be used to cover-up. Which one is correct? Zazakallahu khairan. Answer ID: 7599 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1223/208=TL/1429) Yawning should be controlled as much as possible, if not possible one should put the back of left palm on mouth: ووجہ القیل اظھر لانہ لدفع الشیطان کما مر وھی بالیسار اولی، ? وقدمنا فی آداب الصلاۃ عن الصلاۃ عن الضیاء انہ بظھر الیسری ( شامی 2:13 ) One can put his right hand whether palm or back of palm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
